scope: Eight finite/local groups. No irrationality, spherical-shell, contact classification or quantum Langlands theorem certified.

periodic_height_correction.scope: one-dimensional drift-Laplacian analogue, not a complex surface

symmetric_contact_jet.scope: standard symplectic projective model; not existence on arbitrary contact manifolds

kummer_euler.scope: Laurent polynomial de Rham differential, not stack descent
